title: Fleeing Sudan's war, refugees rebuild their lives in Uganda
summary: On the outskirts of the Ugandan town of Biale, tents are scattered along dirt roads that give way to open fields. The Kriandongo camp sits between a shattered past and a life tentatively being rebuilt. Here, the story does not end with fleeing war.
